dimensions.description: Medium changes artifacts, conventions and handoff behaviour where required.
Genre expectations shape conflict, information, rhythm or audience experience without becoming a formula.
Style is expressed through operational writing/performance characteristics, not labels alone.
Audience guidance materially affects content only when relevant.
Voice roles/performance direction are coherent; no unverified provider IDs are invented.
Pack constraints remain consistent through development, writing, evaluation and revision.
Intentional pack traits are preserved while genuine defects remain detectable.
Narrative hands off downstream requirements without taking ownership of visual/audio/game implementation.
